rules: GENE includes named genes, gene products, proteins, enzymes, antibodies and named protein complexes when used as biological entities in this corpus.

Use the specific mention boundary supported by context. Gene/protein head nouns and modifiers sometimes belong to the annotation; they are not always included. Do not blindly append gene, protein, antibody, loci or promoter.
Separate independently named items in a list. Keep their original punctuation and spacing. Generic experimental methods and ordinary biological processes are not gene names.
A shorter core name inside a longer annotated mention is not automatically an additional entity.

examples.sentence: Serum gamma glutamyltransferase in the diagnosis of liver disease in cattle .
Takayasu ' s disease : association with HLA - B5 .
SGPT , SGOT , and alkaline phosphatase concentrations were essentially normal in all subjects .
